_instructions: The software EPAY builds on top of the POS. Content from the EPAY App Store material on epaypos.net. Do not list anything here we do not actually ship.
heading: Software EPAY Builds on Top of the POS
lede: The App Store turns the register into a platform. These are the tools we build and support ourselves, and they run off the same catalog, customers and reporting as everything else.

faqs.q: What software runs on the EPAY POS?
faqs.a: The tools EPAY builds and supports itself run off the same catalog, customers and reporting as the register — including EPAY Terminal for keypad payments and Loyalty for points, rewards and discounts.
They run on the same system and the same data rather than being separate products with separate logins. Pricing for your setup is confirmed against your statement before you commit.

faqs.q: Do apps share data with the register?
faqs.a: Yes, that is the point of building them on the POS — one catalog, one customer list and one set of reporting, rather than a second system to reconcile.

apps.name: EPAY Terminal
apps.body: A plain keypad for taking payments, running on the EPAY Mini. Type the amount, tap or insert the card, print the receipt — no catalog to build and nothing for staff to learn. Turn it on when a register is more than the job needs.

apps.name: Loyalty
apps.body: Points, rewards or discounts that apply automatically at checkout, tied to customer profiles with purchase history.

apps.name: E-Commerce Storefront
apps.body: A fully integrated online store launched from the system, running off the same catalog and inventory as the counter.

apps.name: Online Ordering
apps.body: Your own ordering page. Orders land directly in the POS alongside everything else.

apps.name: Reservations and Waitlist
apps.body: In-house bookings, online reservations and walk-ins on one screen, synced to table management.

apps.name: Gift Cards
apps.body: Custom-branded digital and physical cards sold, tracked and redeemed from the POS with no third-party setup.

apps.name: Advanced Reporting
apps.body: Sales, labor and top items by daypart, category, employee or location, on the desk or on your phone.
